faqs.question: How quickly will I get a response?
faqs.answer: WhatsApp messages are typically answered within minutes. Phone calls are answered live 24/7. Contact form enquiries are answered within a few hours.

faqs.question: Can I book a chauffeur for right now?
faqs.answer: Yes — for urgent, same-hour requests, WhatsApp or call us directly rather than using the online form. We'll confirm availability immediately.

faqs.question: How do I set up a corporate account?
faqs.answer: WhatsApp or call us with your company details and typical travel needs, and our team will set up a standing account with invoicing.

faqs.question: Can I change or cancel a booking through this page?
faqs.answer: For changes to an existing booking, WhatsApp or call us directly with your reference number — it's the fastest way to update a live booking.

faqs.question: What information should I include when I message you on WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Your pickup and drop-off locations, date and time, number of passengers, and your preferred vehicle — the more detail you share upfront, the faster we can confirm.

faqs.question: Can I request a specific vehicle when contacting you?
faqs.answer: Yes, mention your preferred vehicle when you contact us and we'll confirm availability along with your booking.

faqs.question: Do you respond to enquiries from outside the UAE?
faqs.answer: Yes, we respond to enquiries from anywhere — many of our bookings are made by travelers before they even land in Dubai.

faqs.question: Is support available in languages other than English?
faqs.answer: Yes, several of our team members and chauffeurs are multilingual — let us know your preferred language when you reach out.

faqs.question: Can I request a callback instead of messaging first?
faqs.answer: Yes, leave your number via WhatsApp or the contact form and our team will call you back directly.

faqs.question: Do you charge for a quote or consultation?
faqs.answer: No, quotes and consultations are completely free — you only pay once a booking is confirmed.
